configurations.name: Commit & Push
configurations.command: git add -A && git status --short && if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'Nothing new to commit.'; else git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"; fi && echo 'Pulling latest changes from GitHub...' && { git pull --rebase origin "$(git branch --show-current)" || { echo 'Pull stopped on a conflict: nothing was pushed. Resolve the conflict and run git rebase --continue, or undo the pull with git rebase --abort.'; exit 1; }; } && git push -u origin HEAD
